title: 1Clob
tagline: AI-powered CLOB trading platform for smarter entries, exits, and real-time crypto market insights.
description:
1CLOB is an advanced AI-powered decentralized trading platform built on top of 1inch's Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) infrastructure. It brings intelligent market analysis, real-time trading signals, and deep market data into a single seamless UI to help traders maximize profit and minimize losses.

Our platform is designed for both beginner and pro traders who want more confidence and control over their trading. The core AI module identifies support and resistance zones, evaluates risk levels (low/medium/high), and generates actionable trading insights based on real-time price data, volume trends, and technical indicators like RSI and EMA.

On the backend, we integrate multiple APIs including CoinGecko and CryptoCompare for real-time and historical price feeds. On the execution side, we leverage 1inch’s CLOB technology for professional-grade order matching, deep liquidity access, MEV protection, and multi-chain settlement.

Users can interact with the platform through a clean, modern frontend, navigate to a trading interface with live price data, place limit orders, and use our interactive API explorer to directly test 1inch’s CLOB APIs. We also provide detailed analytics on each token’s price history, market depth, and trading volume to aid informed decision-making.
how_its_made:
The frontend is built using Next.js 14, React, and TypeScript, styled with Tailwind CSS and animated using Framer Motion. We use shadcn/ui for a consistent, modular UI design. Data visualization, live analytics, and responsiveness are key focuses of the interface.

Here’s how the system works under the hood:

Real-time Price & Volume Data: Integrated via CoinGecko and CryptoCompare APIs for accurate token metrics.

Trade Execution & Market Depth: Powered by 1inch’s CLOB APIs, enabling professional-grade limit orders and cross-chain liquidity.

AI Engine: Custom AI logic processes chart patterns and indicators (like RSI, EMA) to detect support/resistance zones, generate entry/exit signals, and assess risk levels (Low/Medium/High).

Swagger Integration: We provide a dedicated Swagger route where users can interactively test all 1inch CLOB APIs, including placing orders, fetching depth, and managing positions.
